<p style="margin-left: 40px;">Retirement is the perfect time to read (and reread) the great books! <a href="http://www.sjc.edu/summer-classics-santa-fe-2026"><strong><font color="#f2665a">Summer Classics</font></strong></a> at St. John’s College is a 35-year-old seasonal program conceived in the spirit of lifelong learning.
